findings.evidence: ## The N+1 query problem restates the one-query-per-row versus JOIN pattern, which the description excludes as tuning a query without a schema change
findings.fix: Keep only the bind-parameter rule and the pointer to the FK-index gotcha; move the N+1 tutorial out of this skill into the query skill that owns it, and add a para row to docs/audit/recovery/database-schema-designer/record.md

findings.evidence: The References table gates migrations.md, schema-design-checklist.md, schema-fundamentals.md and migration-template.sql, but never says which of the other three not to load for a given scenario
findings.fix: Add a Do not load cell that names the other optional files for each row, for example do not load schema-fundamentals.md or schema-design-checklist.md while writing a live migration

findings.evidence: Use a UUID when keys are generated by several systems offers no default generator or native type, only a pointer to the engine docs
findings.fix: Default to the engine native type (PostgreSQL uuid with gen_random_uuid()) and keep the docs read as the escape hatch for other engines

findings.evidence: mysql-myisam-foreign-key and mysql-explain-on-writes-and-reading-plans have realistic prompts and verifiable assertions but no input schema under evals/files/, unlike the other engine evals
findings.fix: Add evals/files/mysql-myisam-orders.sql and evals/files/mysql-explain-orders.sql and list them in those evals' files arrays

findings.evidence: Workflow step 2 tells the agent to use EXPLAIN ANALYZE on MySQL for reads, while the EXPLAIN gotcha says MySQL 8.4 measures only SELECT, TABLE and multi-table UPDATE/DELETE
findings.fix: In step 2, restrict MySQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE to SELECT, TABLE and multi-table UPDATE/DELETE, and point single-table writes at plain EXPLAIN

findings.evidence: SQLite rebuild step 1 says start the script with .bail on (sqlite3 CLI) and step 9 relies on it to exit before COMMIT, with only one sentence for an application connection
findings.fix: Lead the procedure with the application path (BEGIN plus ROLLBACK on the first error) and mark .bail on as the sqlite3 CLI variant only
